# dim_advisor_events_suppliers

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_advisor_events_suppliers` · dbt area: `advisor_events`

Bridge table mapping suppliers to advisor events, with a flag indicating whether each supplier was the primary event partner. Sourced from Splash data (via Google Sheets) and joined to events via event name.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `event_participation_supplier_id` | The unique ID for an event's participating supplier. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `event_id` | The event ID. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `is_primary_supplier` | True/False flag of whether the supplier was the primary event partner. SOURCE >> Google Sheets |
| `supplier_id` | The supplier_id associated with the supplier. SOURCE >> Google Sheets |
